You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Customer Engagement and Service Delivery Welcome and acknowledge customers in a warm, respectful, and professional manner. jobs.title: Marketing Events Associate
jobs.description: Adarna House is in need of a highly organized, meticulous, and communicative Activations Lead who loves storytelling. This role is similar to a project manager in that you will manage Adarna House events and marketing partnerships to create meaningful experiences for our readers. You will work with a Creatives team and a Digital Marketing team to plan, promote, and execute various on-site brand activations. Responsibilities include: Marketing Event Execution Plan concept and execution of various events including but not limited to book fairs, workshops, and book launches. Execute activities within a predefined budget by proposing budget, and canvassing suppliers and vendors. Manage all aspects of Adarna House’s live storytelling service including storyteller deployment, assessment, and training. Be responsible for event outcomes including attendance rate and participant satisfaction. Partnerships Management Manage brand collaborations and partnerships. Be a point person for representing Adarna House’s marketing team to external partners and clients. Maintain a positive relationship with external collaborators such as Adarna House book creators, content creators, storytellers, and various brands & organizations. Team Coordination Be a project lead for marketing events including assigning event roles, tracking and distributing project budget, and communicating with other departments. Lead the continuous improvement of events and partnerships executions, including creating event reports and running post-mortem meetings. You will succeed in this role if you can Be entrusted to execute an on-site event from start to finish with full accountability. Maintain healthy communications with several overlapping internal and external collaborators, keeping everyone in the loop. Both comfortably client-face and confidently rally colleagues.

jobs.title: Leasing Manager
jobs.description: Job Title: Leasing Manager (Restaurant Site Acquisition & Expansion) Industry: Restaurants, F&B and franchise brand expansion Brand Coverage: Hooters, Rock Shops, Scoozi, VK and future brands Salary: THB 35,000 per month + THB 10,000 per successfully leased location (commission) Destination Eats is seeking a proactive Leasing Manager to identify, evaluate and secure suitable restaurant premises for its brands. Based in Bangkok, the role will develop a pipeline of potential sites, negotiate commercial terms for management approval, and coordinate lease completion and handover. Each location must meet the relevant brand's customer, operational and financial requirements. Key Job Responsibilities: Source suitable locations: Identify opportunities through landlords, shopping-centre leasing teams, developers and property agents. Build a pipeline aligned with brand requirements and approved expansion priorities. Assess site suitability: Evaluate catchment, visibility, access, competition and delivery potential. Coordinate checks on restaurant use, kitchen and utility requirements, exhaust, drainage, grease management and signage. Prepare commercial proposals: Work with Operations and Finance on site proposals and occupancy-cost comparisons, including rent, service charges, fit-out requirements and other financial commitments. Negotiate lease terms: Negotiate rent, escalation, lease duration, rent-free and fit-out periods, renewal options, operating conditions and other terms for management approval. Coordinate approvals and completion: Work with Operations, Finance, Legal and Projects on due diligence, required brand or franchisor approvals, lease documentation, execution, and site handover. Manage relationships and reporting: Maintain an accurate site pipeline and weekly progress updates. Build landlord relationships and support existing-site lease matters, renewals and renegotiations as assigned.

jobs.title: Solutions Designer
jobs.description: The Solutions Designer serves as the overall technical lead for assigned projects. This role is responsible for translating high-level architectural designs into detailed technical solutions, leading the technical implementation, and ensuring end-to-end system integration and delivery that meets business and operational requirements. Leads the creation of the Solution Plan (SP) based on the High-Level Solution (HLS) provided by the Solution Architect. Collaborates with the System Analyst to break down the HLS into actionable technical packages across applications and components. Works closely with the Project Manager (PM) and Business Analyst (BA) to refine and validate business and technical requirements. Reviews and validates the Detailed Functional Specification (DFS) with the System Analyst to ensure alignment with the planned solution. Coordinates with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), Network Engineers, and Security teams to ensure holistic and secure end-to-end system design. Oversees the setup of testing and production environments in collaboration with System Administrators and Database Administrators through the System Analyst. Supports the Systems Analyst during the production handover process. Leads technical readiness activities, ensuring support teams are prepared to manage the system post-deployment. Oversees cutover planning and execution for deploying system enhancements into production. Provides technical leadership during the stabilization period after deployment, managing escalations and production issues. Partners with the PM and Service Management team to monitor system performance and assist with project closeout and knowledge transfer.
